senses.definition: An act or instance of lending, an act or instance of granting something for temporary use.
senses.example: Because of the loan that John made to me, I was able to pay my tuition for the upcoming semester.

senses.definition: A sum of money or other property that a natural or legal person borrows from another with the condition that it be returned or repaid over time or at a later date (sometimes with interest).
senses.example: All loans from the library, whether books or audio material, must be returned within two weeks.

senses.definition: The contract and array of legal or ethical obligations surrounding a loan.
senses.example: He made a payment on his loan.

senses.definition: The permission to borrow any item.
senses.example: Thank you for the loan of your lawn mower.

In the course of a correspondence that passed between us at this period, he mentioned, to my utter astonishment, the fact of his having loaned Neilson 81000 to buy my bill on Maryland; and stated that he could not proceed to make the payment until Neilson refunded the money.

senses.definition: An area of uncultivated ground near a village or farmhouse.
senses.example: the Loan of Turchloy, the Black Loan
